subject: I can no longer deploy my app...curl error message

messages.author: d6da36e2f4b0f4c3
messages.subject: I can no longer deploy my app...curl error message
parts:
My app was working fine until I tried to re-deploy it today. I did not change anything, but i did get this error message when running the shinyapps::setAccountInfo command.

Error in curlSetOpt(..., .opts = .opts, curl = h, .encoding = .encoding) : 
  VECTOR_ELT() can only be applied to a 'list', not a 'character'

Any ideas how to solve this?
